clips.text: Hi, I'd like to book a room please. Of course, could I take your first name? Yes, it's Sophie. Lovely, Sophie.
And the postcode for the booking? That's B S three, four P R. B S three four P R, perfect, thank you.
How many nights would you like to stay? Three nights please, from Monday. Three nights from Monday, confirmed.
And how will you be paying today? I'll pay by credit card now if that's alright. Credit card now, lovely.
Any special requests for your stay? Could I have a late checkout, please? Late checkout, I'll add that to the notes.
Welcome to the museum, everyone. All tours start here at the information desk, just to your left as you come in.
If you'd like a souvenir, our gift shop is on the ground floor, right by the main entrance. Easy to find.
Looking at the map in front of you, directly east of the central fountain you'll find the sculpture garden.
The next guided tour begins at eleven thirty, so please be back at the information desk a few minutes before.
One quick reminder: photography is permitted only in the temporary exhibition rooms on the first floor.
Anna: Honestly, the main weakness of our methodology was the sample size. Fifteen participants was just too small to draw conclusions from.
Ben: I think our literature review is already sufficient. Supervisor: That's exactly where I'd push back, Ben. It really isn't sufficient yet.
Anna: We have to hit Friday. Ben: Agreed, the deadline matters most. Supervisor: Deadlines mean nothing if the work isn't actually ready.
Supervisor: For your follow-up task, please submit a polished draft to me by Friday. That's the priority for now.
Supervisor: Overall I'd say I'm cautiously supportive. The direction is sound, but the execution still needs noticeable work.
Today we'll see that coastal erosion is driven primarily by wave action: the relentless impact of waves against the shoreline.
On average, soft cliffs retreat at roughly one metre per year, though this figure rises sharply after major storms.
Sea defences are most effective when combined with beach nourishment, that is, adding sand to widen the beach.
Managed retreat is preferable in many cases because it is far more cost-effective than building hard defences.
A striking example is the village of Happisburgh on the Norfolk coast, which has lost dozens of homes to the sea.
